properties.name: SUPERAGENT AI
properties.description:
SUPERAGENT is the first real-time AI sales assistant built specifically for insurance professionals, designed to close, support, and empower agents on every call.

Built by industry veterans and AI experts, SUPERAGENT embeds your agency’s products, scripts, and sales strategy into a live co-pilot that listens in, identifies objections, and delivers high-impact suggestions in the moment. It’s how your average rep starts performing like your best agent, every single time.

Why It Matters:
25% of agents will retire in the next 4 years. Insurance leaders face shrinking pipelines, rising churn, and a younger workforce that expects modern tools, not outdated call scripts and static training modules. The future of insurance sales depends on better onboarding, smarter enablement, and scalable performance.

That’s where SUPERAGENT steps in.

We’re not just building a tool, we’re changing the trajectory of the insurance sales profession, one conversation at a time.

Led by a world-class founding team:
Vadym Shashkov (AI/ML expert with 8+ years experience)
Vlada Lotkina (EdTech founder, 5M users)

📍 Join us in building the future of insurance sales.
🔗 Learn more at www.getsuperagent.com
